name: blazingcdn-mcp
description: Manage BlazingCDN from AI agents: CDN zones, cache, metrics, domains, cloud storage and video CDN
long_description: Official MCP server for BlazingCDN — a CDN for video, software & sports media. 52 tools covering Anycast CDN resources, cache purge/warmup, traffic metrics, custom domains, cloud storage and the Video CDN. Safe by default: read-only until write/delete are explicitly enabled; destructive operations are not implemented at all.

api_token.title: BlazingCDN API token
api_token.description: In the BlazingCDN panel open API (client.blazingcdn.com/api), create new API credentials and paste the token here

allow_write.title: Allow changes
allow_write.description: Let Claude create and change CDN settings: turn on image processing, adjust caching, add domains. Leave unchecked for read-only access (settings, statistics and cache purge still work)

allow_delete.title: Allow deleting
allow_delete.description: Let Claude delete custom domains and Video CDN resources. CDN resources, storage buckets and your account can never be deleted through this extension

tools.name: list_cdn_resources
tools.description: List Anycast CDN resources (pull zones) in the account with their settings, domains and state.

tools.name: get_cdn_resource
tools.description: Get full details of one Anycast CDN resource (pull zone): origin, TTLs, compression, origin shield, domains, locations.

tools.name: create_cdn_resource
tools.description: Create a new Anycast CDN resource (pull zone).

tools.name: update_cdn_resource
tools.description: Update settings of an Anycast CDN resource (pull zone): caching/TTLs, compression, origin shield, HTTPS, access protection (hotlink, country, IP, URL signing),…

tools.name: bulk_update_cdn_resources
tools.description: Apply the same settings to several Anycast CDN resources (pull zones) at once.

tools.name: update_cdn_locations
tools.description: Update per-location (URL path) cache rules of an aCDN resource.

tools.name: purge_cache
tools.description: Purge cached content.

tools.name: warmup_cache
tools.description: Pre-fetch (warm up) content into the aCDN resource cache for the given paths, optionally per compression method.

tools.name: get_cdn_metrics
tools.description: Get Anycast CDN metrics for the whole account or a single resource.

tools.name: get_prometheus_metrics
tools.description: Fetch Prometheus-format metrics for monitoring dashboards: source 'cdn' for Anycast CDN, 'cloud_storage' for Cloud Store.

tools.name: list_custom_domains

tools.name: search_custom_domains

tools.name: list_system_dns_zones

tools.name: add_custom_domain

tools.name: update_custom_domain

tools.name: delete_custom_domain
